A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present CQSTR, a cloud container system that enables cloud providers to securely deploy and verify the properties of services.
we are developing new abstractions for cloud computing that allow clients to verify the security of services.

CQSTR provides the following features: (i) it allows clients to specify and validate security properties of services; (ii) it provides an abstraction that allows cloud containers to be deployed and managed in a way that is independent from the underlying IaaS platform; (iii) it provides a mechanism for enforcing security policies on cloud containers, and (iv) it provides a means to verify that cloud containers are securely deployed.

the cloud can provide a new model for securing services, one that can be used by clients to verify that a service is secure.
